<div class="card-body">
'''Sorry About The Mess''' is a [[Light]] [[Interrupt]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">やっかいかけたな</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">自分の支配フェイズに武器を使用する（フォースは通常通り使用する）。使用しているのがハンなら、運命数に1を加えられる。（シーカーを目標とすることもできる。シーカーは回避値4としてあつかう）命中を受けた目標は即座にロストする。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Sorry-About-The-Mess-SWCA-67676.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">「おまえを殺すのを楽しみにしてたんだ」「ああ、察しがつくぜ」ハンはグリードとの交渉に荒っぽく片をつけ、ウーハーに後始末料を投げてよこした。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Sorry About The Mess.

'''Card text:'''
During your control phase, fire a weapon, using Force as usual. If Han is firing, you may add 1 to destiny. A seeker may be targeted. Treat a seeker as maneuver 4. A hit target is immediately lost.

'''Lore:'''
I've been looking forward to killing you. Yeah, I figured. Han ended the talk with Greedo roughly and tossed Wuher a cleanup fee.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Title is やっかいかけたな.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Sorry About The Mess]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
